text: 10.1 1 We haven't been to the cinema for ages. Do you fancy going tonight? Erm... not really. I checked earlier and there's nothing on. Oh... well, how about something to eat? We could try that new steakhouse on the high street. Actually, I'd rather go at the weekend if that's OK with you. There's quite a good film on later tonight. Okay, another night in front of the TV then.
